subject: general
question: The 'Malanjkhand' is a famous mines of _______ mineral in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Malanjkhand copper mines** are located in the Balaghat district of Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• Malanjkhand is India's largest open-pit copper mine, and it was developed by **Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL).**
 
• The mine was **discovered in 1969 **and has been operational since 1982. It is one of the most important copper-producing regions in India.
 
• The ore extracted from Malanjkhand contains copper along with **traces of silver, gold, and molybdenum**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bailadila Iron Ore Mines** is in Dantewada district, Chhattisgarh.
 
• Supplies iron ore to steel plants across India, including in Visakhapatnam and Bhilai.
 
• **Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) (Karnataka) **One of the oldest and deepest gold mines in India, operational since the 19th century.
 
• **Jaduguda Uranium Mines** East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand.
 
• This is India's** first uranium mine**, operational since 1967. Managed By: Uranium Corporation of India Ltd (UCIL).
 
• **Jharia Coal Mines** Dhanbad district, Jharkhand. The **largest coal producer** in India and known for its high-quality bituminous coal.
 
• **Majhgawan Diamond Mines **Panna district, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The **only active diamond-producing region** in India, contributing to the country's diamond production.
